Customer_email.title: Customer email
Customer_email.description: Where should the test promo code be delivered? Use your own mailbox first.

Customer_name.title: Customer name
Customer_name.description: Will appear in the email greeting.

Brand_name.title: Brand name
Brand_name.description: Will appear as the sender brand in the body.

Promo_code.title: Promo code
Promo_code.description: The code that will be shown in the test email.

Currency.title: Currency
Currency.description: ISO currency code (KWD / AED / SAR / QAR / BHD / OMR).

Manually_trigger_a_flow.description: Manual button trigger — fill in the fields, click Run, you receive a real promo-code email in the customer mailbox you specified. Use this BEFORE wiring up the live outbound flow to confirm Power Automate + Office 365 + your mailbox are working end to end.

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Dear @{triggerBody()?['Customer_name']},

We apologize for the inconvenience you experienced.

As a goodwill gesture, please use the following code on your next order at @{triggerBody()?['Brand_name']}:

Code@{triggerBody()?['Promo_code']}
Value@{triggerBody()?['Value']} @{triggerBody()?['Currency']}
Expires@{triggerBody()?['Expires_at']}

We hope to serve you better next time.

— The @{triggerBody()?['Brand_name']} Team

This is a test email sent from the WOW Refund Power Automate diagnostic flow. The promo code above is not a live code unless you happened to type a real one. Template: CUSTOMER_PROMO_COMPENSATION.

Send_an_email_(V2).description: Sends the same shape of email that the live CUSTOMER_PROMO_COMPENSATION template produces, so when the live outbound flow goes online you already know your Outlook connection + mailbox + sender identity all work.
